question: What process does QuickLeave replace?
required_answer: Requesting leave by email and tracking leave balances in a shared spreadsheet.
expected_answer: QuickLeave replaces requesting leave by email and tracking balances in a shared spreadsheet.

question: What target does QuickLeave set for the time it takes to approve a leave request?
required_answer: Under 4 hours.
optional_details: Down from an average of 2 days today.
expected_answer: Reduce the approval time from an average of 2 days to under 4 hours.

question: If a public holiday falls inside someone's leave period, is it taken from their leave balance?
required_answer: No. Weekends and public holidays inside the leave period are not counted against the balance (FR-08).
expected_answer: No. FR-08: weekends and public holidays inside the leave period must not be counted against the balance.
notes: Paraphrased question (taken from / balance); the answer is a No that the spec states directly.

question: Roughly how many tokens did each training batch of the Transformer contain?
required_answer: About 25000 source tokens and 25000 target tokens.
expected_answer: Each training batch contained approximately 25000 source tokens and 25000 target tokens.

question: Did one training step of the big Transformer take more than twice as long as a step of the base model?
required_answer: Yes. A big-model step took 1.0 seconds against about 0.4 seconds for the base model (2.5 times as long).
expected_answer: Yes. Base-model steps took about 0.4 seconds and big-model steps 1.0 seconds, 2.5 times as long.

question: What operating modes does DevPilot AI have?
required_answer: Three: Ask, Plan and Agent.
optional_details: The modes are enforced structurally at the API layer, so restricted modes never receive write or execute operations.
expected_answer: Three operating modes, Ask, Plan and Agent, enforced structurally at the API layer.

question: In ReleaseForge AI, what raised GPT-4o-mini's precision from 78.6%, and what precision did it reach?
required_answer: An independent second-pass verification call; precision reached 94%.
optional_details: It also reached 100% critical-defect catch and 96% recall (3-run mean).
expected_answer: An independent second-pass verification call lifted precision from 78.6% to 94% (with 100% critical-defect catch and 96% recall, 3-run mean).

question: Does the resume mention any experience with Terraform?
required_answer: No. The resume does not mention Terraform.
optional_details: Its infrastructure skills list Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI/CD and Azure.
expected_answer: No. The resume does not mention Terraform; its infrastructure skills are Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI/CD and Azure.
notes: Negative-evidence question: the resume is the right document and does not mention it. 'No, not mentioned' with found=true is the correct reply; a bare 'not found' is a weaker answer.

question: What is the code for Maternity Leave, and how many days per year does it give?
required_answer: ML, 182 days per year.
optional_details: It cannot be carried forward and needs a document.
expected_answer: Maternity Leave has the code ML and gives 182 days per year.

question: Can all three QuickLeave roles approve leave requests?
required_answer: No. Managers and HR Admins can approve or reject requests; Employees cannot.
expected_answer: No. Only Managers (for their team) and HR Admins can approve or reject requests; an Employee can apply, cancel own pending requests and view own balance.
notes: Comparison over every row of the roles table ('all').

question: Did the 4-layer Transformer beat every WSJ-only discriminative parser listed in Table 4?
required_answer: No. It scored 91.3 F1, below Dyer et al. (2016) at 91.7.
optional_details: It beat Vinyals & Kaiser (88.3), Petrov et al. (90.4) and Zhu et al. (90.4).
expected_answer: No. The 4-layer Transformer (WSJ only) got 91.3 F1, higher than 88.3 and 90.4 but lower than Dyer et al. (2016) at 91.7.
notes: Comparison ('every'): one row beats the Transformer.

question: Which non-Transformer model in Table 2 has the highest English-to-French BLEU score, and what is it?
required_answer: ConvS2S Ensemble, with 41.29 BLEU.
expected_answer: The ConvS2S Ensemble, at 41.29 BLEU on English-to-French.
notes: Max over a table column, excluding the Transformer rows (41.8 big, 38.1 base).

question: What can an HR Admin do in QuickLeave that a Manager cannot?
required_answer: Edit leave types, adjust any balance, upload the yearly public holiday CSV, and cancel approved requests.
optional_details: Unanswered requests are escalated to the HR Admin after 72 hours (FR-06).
expected_answer: An HR Admin can edit leave types and adjust any balance (roles table), upload the yearly public holiday list as a CSV (FR-09, POST /api/v1/holidays/upload), and cancel approved requests (FR-07).
source_section: 3. Users and Roles; 4. Functional Requirements (FR-07, FR-09); 7. API Endpoints

question: What must a rejection include, and which endpoint rejects a request?
required_answer: A comment; PATCH /api/v1/leave-requests/{id}/reject.
optional_details: Managers and HR Admins may call it.
expected_answer: A rejection must include a comment (FR-05). It is done with PATCH /api/v1/leave-requests/{id}/reject, by a Manager or HR Admin.

question: How many attention heads does the base Transformer use, and what happened to quality with a single head or with too many heads?
required_answer: 8 heads. Single-head attention was 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, and quality also dropped off with too many heads.
expected_answer: The base model uses h = 8 heads. In Table 3 rows (A), single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, and quality also drops off with too many heads.

question: Which of the candidate's projects use Ollama?
required_answer: IntelliFusion and DevPilot AI.
optional_details: IntelliFusion benchmarked a self-hosted Ollama model (Qwen2.5, LLaVA) against GPT-4o-mini; DevPilot AI serves its fine-tuned model locally through Ollama.
expected_answer: IntelliFusion (a self-hosted Ollama model benchmarked against GPT-4o-mini) and DevPilot AI (local serving of the fine-tuned model through Ollama).

question: What does error code QL-1005 mean, and which HTTP status does it return?
required_answer: 403: the user is not allowed to perform this action.
expected_answer: QL-1005 returns HTTP 403 and means the user is not allowed to perform this action.

question: What is the document ID of the QuickLeave specification?
required_answer: QL-SPEC-001.
expected_answer: QL-SPEC-001.

question: How many checkpoints were averaged for the big Transformer models?
required_answer: The last 20 checkpoints.
optional_details: The base models averaged the last 5 checkpoints, written at 10-minute intervals.
expected_answer: The last 20 checkpoints (the base models averaged the last 5).
notes: Base (5) and big (20) sit in neighbouring sentences: a fact-attribution trap.

question: QuickLeave pages must load in under 2 seconds at the 95th percentile (NFR-01). Has the candidate measured p95 latency in a project?
required_answer: Yes. In DevPilot AI the candidate measured p95 latency (8.99s for the fine-tuned model vs 7.26s for the base model).
expected_answer: Yes. NFR-01 requires p95 page loads under 2 seconds; in DevPilot AI the candidate measured median latency 2.86s vs 3.28s and p95 8.99s vs 7.26s.

question: QuickLeave must meet WCAG 2.1 level AA (NFR-05). Does the resume mention accessibility or WCAG experience?
required_answer: No. The resume does not mention accessibility or WCAG.
optional_details: NFR-05 requires the user interface to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA.
expected_answer: No. The spec requires WCAG 2.1 level AA (NFR-05), but the resume does not mention accessibility or WCAG experience.
notes: Negative-evidence question: 'No, not mentioned' with found=true is correct; 'Yes' is a hallucination.

question: QuickLeave plans iOS and Android apps for a later release. Does the resume show any mobile app development?
required_answer: No. The resume does not mention mobile app development.
optional_details: Mobile apps (iOS and Android) are out of scope for QuickLeave v1. The candidate's web work includes the Meeting Room Web App.
expected_answer: No. Mobile apps are planned for a later QuickLeave release, and the resume does not mention iOS, Android or mobile app development.
notes: Negative-evidence question. Trap: the Meeting Room Web App is a web app, not a mobile app.

expected_answer: ABSTAIN: the spec gives no budget.

expected_answer: ABSTAIN: the resume does not name a manager.
